findings.value: A pub in railway arches beside Hoxton Station, serving food, with a garden and covered outside seating, according to its CAMRA WhatPub entry.

evidence.quote: In restored railway arches next to Hoxton Station.

findings.value: CAMRA's WhatPub entry lists live music among the pub's facilities; the kind of nights is not stated.

notes: Only CAMRA WhatPub was read; one WebSearch found no press review. The CAMRA description says 'Former on-site brewery closed March 2025.' (page last updated 05/08/2026). That is a change at the pub, not a closure, so it is passed on rather than proposed. No live-music listing was read.
